observation: Fresh main labels every non-directory Dirent in WorkspaceService.tree as type=file. Symlinks and other special entries are therefore advertised as regular files even though manifest excludes non-files and contextBundle rejects symlinks, creating a false repository observation at the API tree boundary.
changes: Reuse the existing Dirent file/directory distinction and omit entries that are neither regular files nor directories before tree classification.
Keep the existing tree type vocabulary unchanged instead of inventing a new symlink product contract.
Add a focused regression proving an in-workspace symlink is not misclassified as a regular file while ordinary files/directories remain visible.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: tree mapped any non-directory Dirent to type=file while manifest/contextBundle already distinguish special entries.
verification.focused_bounded_replay: PASS 1/1 on Linux host: a real symlink was created and the proposed Dirent boundary returned only the regular file and directory.
verification.regression_contract: tests/workspace-tree-special-entry-integrity.test.mjs exercises WorkspaceService.tree together with manifest/contextBundle special-entry behavior.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime health remained transiently unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted/full repository suite pass is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle does not decide whether Taowind Code should expose symlinks as a first-class UI/API type. It only prevents the existing two-type tree contract from falsely calling special entries regular files.
